title: Bigger sample

feedback.message: The sample size grew by a factor of [$k], so the SD shrinks by √[$k], not [$k].

hints: By what factor did the sample size grow?
The SD shrinks by the square root of that factor.
solution: The sample size is [$k] times bigger, so the SD is divided by $\sqrt{[$k]} = [$rk]$: $[$d]/[$rk]$.
